queries.text: We need to model L. monocytogenes growth in vacuum-packed sliced turkey deli meat during retail display. Assume typical retail refrigeration. The product has a 35-day shelf life. What growth can we expect?
queries.notes: Motivating example. Frontier models (e.g., gpt-4o) extract duration from 'shelf life of 35 days' (35*24*60 = 50400 minutes). Some open-source models (e.g., Gemma) fail to populate duration_minutes at all.
